summary: Season calendar management feature tested end-to-end. Backend API endpoints (GET /api/season, PUT /api/admin/season) working correctly with proper validation. Frontend displays correct phase-specific messages across all components (hero ribbon, countdown, timeline). All phases tested: pre-KvK, S2 without end date, S2 with end date, and open phase. Original calendar successfully restored.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/season returns current season config
Backend: PUT /api/admin/season validation rejects open date before s2 date (422)
Backend: PUT /api/admin/season updates s2_start with null recruit_open
Backend: PUT /api/admin/season updates both s2_start and recruit_open
Backend: PUT /api/admin/season sets open phase (both dates past)
Backend: Original season config restored successfully
Frontend: Hero ribbon shows 'PRÉ-KVK — LA SAISON 2 COMMENCE FIN OCTOBRE' in pre phase
Frontend: Apply countdown shows 'DÉBUT DE LA SAISON 2' (NOT 'OUVERTURE DES PORTES') in pre phase
Frontend: Countdown data-phase='pre' in pre phase
Frontend: Timeline shows Pré-KvK as current step with ship indicator in pre phase
Frontend: Admin season panel accessible and displays current phase
Frontend: Hero ribbon shows 'SAISON 2 EN COURS' in s2 phase without end date
Frontend: Countdown shows 'SAISON 2 EN COURS · PORTES : FIN DE SAISON (DATE À VENIR)' when recruit_open is null
Frontend: Timeline shows Saison 2 as current step in s2 phase
Frontend: Timeline s2end date shows 'DATE ANNONCÉE PROCHAINEMENT' when recruit_open is null
Frontend: Countdown shows 'OUVERTURE DES PORTES' with date '15 janvier 2027' in s2 phase with end date
Frontend: Hero ribbon shows 'FIN DE SAISON 2 — LES PORTES SONT OUVERTES' in open phase
Frontend: Countdown shows 'PORTES OUVERTES — LE CONSEIL EMBARQUE' in open phase
Frontend: Timeline shows 'Fin de saison 2' as current step with 'OUVERT — EMBARQUEZ !' status in open phase
Frontend: Original calendar restored and verified - site back to PRÉ-KVK phase
